title: 第11章 最难消受美人恩第12章 把龙王爷得罪了
slug: 杨戬你爹从朝歌城考编回来了

等杨易喝了龙吉熬的粥之后，龙吉要杨易给他讲讲在入朝为官的经历。
杨易一听，顿时来了兴趣，开始给她讲起了一些朝歌城的奇闻轶事，讲完了奇闻轶事，开始讲自己的经历。
“你姐夫我初入京畿的时候，由于是净身出门，将那银钱都留给了你姐姐，四下闯荡无果，最终跟随一队民夫四处飘零。”
“直到遇到了当时的镇远将军闻仲，也就是如今的闻太师，开始你姐夫我的传奇之旅。”
龙吉兜着手，听得正认真，瑶姬在一旁笑道：“你就听你姐夫瞎吹，你跟了当朝闻太师，然后呢？”
杨易白了瑶姬一眼，道：
“为夫入了闻太师行营，当了一个伙夫，此时正值闻太师欲前往西岐平叛。”
“要说这事还是是先王文丁留下的隐患，当年武乙利用并扶植周国季历征伐戎狄，文丁因季历之功，被册封为西伯侯，授予其统领西方诸侯的权利。”
“然而随着季历连战连捷，势力东扩，先王文丁以封赏为名，将前来献捷的季历诱至商都囚禁，随后将其杀害。”
“虽然是为了遏制周人扩张，却直接导致商周关系恶化，季历死后他的儿子姬昌继承了爵位，这姬昌接班之后琢磨着报复商朝。”
“此事本因东夷叛乱而起，姬昌不愿意出兵伐东夷，于是帝乙下令让闻太师前去攻打西岐，本来有一场大战在即，必是生灵涂炭。”
“你姐夫我洞若观火，知道西岐粮草多是东鲁提供，于是你姐夫我冒死直鉴，让闻太师不发兵，只是以剿匪为名，断了东鲁前往西岐的商道。”
“不出一月，西岐已是大乱，姬昌也明白了自己的短处，为了让东鲁的粮食能进来，于是兵伐东夷。”
“闻太师赏识你姐夫，于是便提拔姐夫成了他帐下谋臣，提名督粮官。”
“这一招叫做不战而屈人之兵，自此之后姬昌知道了粮食的重要性，估摸着现在都在带人垦荒呢。”
“而后你姐夫便一飞冲天，跟随闻太师南征北战，立下汗马功劳，最后平步青云，登临人道权柄的巅峰。”
“现在你姐夫遇人皇而不拜，在朝歌城中跺一脚，整个天下都要抖一抖。”
龙吉这个时候眼睛里面已经冒出来了小星星，“姐夫好厉害。”
然而瑶姬却在这个时候拆台，道：“龙吉，你就听他吹吧，你倒是给我跺一脚试试，看杨家村会不会塌了。”

杨易一听，指着瑶姬说道：“夫人不足与谋。”
一番寒暄之后，瑶姬去给镇上送蚕丝去了，趁着这个机会龙吉溜了进来，一脸神秘兮兮的说道：“姐夫，你说的这些东西我都信。”
杨易淡淡的看了一眼，道：“都是真的，哪里有什么信不信。”
龙吉道：“我看姐夫你通天人，达地理，可否指点我修行一二，以姐夫的眼力劲肯定能看出来，我是修行中人。”
杨易心头一动，这个时候才意识到，龙吉很有可能去见了孔宣，在孔宣面前吃了瘪这才这么老实。
“你姐夫我只是一个普通人，怎么会指点别人修行，你就不要瞎闹了。”
“我不能出来太久，到了明天就要回去了，姐夫，你就可怜一下你这个小姨子。”
谁知道龙吉不管不顾，抱着杨易的手就撒起娇来，那一对明晃晃的在杨易眼前晃来晃去，让杨易心头咯噔一跳。
见到杨易无动于衷，龙吉偷偷凑了过来，道：“我姐姐跟我说，想给你纳一门妾室，要是这件事你能办成，我也可以未尝不是不可以。”
听到龙吉竟然动了这样的念头，杨易脑门一黑，自古最难消受美人恩，杨易虚晃了一枪，拔腿就朝着书房外面跑了出去，龙吉追出来一看，杨易早跑了个没影，气得龙吉眉头一皱。
离开了家之后，杨易一阵汗颜，这天宫里面长大的仙女就是不涉凡尘，心性单纯，被人卖了还帮别人数钱。

After Yang Yi drank the porridge cooked by Long Ji, Long Ji asked Yang Yi to tell him about his experience as an official in the court.
When Yang Yi heard this, he immediately became interested and began to tell her some anecdotes about Chaoge City. After finishing the anecdotes, he started to talk about his own experience.
"When your brother-in-law and I first came to Gyeonggi, I left all the money with your sister because I had to go out to clean myself. I wandered around to no avail, and ended up wandering around with a group of civilians."
"It wasn't until I met Wen Zhong, the then General of Zhenyuan, who is now Grand Master Wen, that my legendary journey began for you, brother-in-law, and me."
Long Ji put his hands in his hands and listened attentively. Yao Ji laughed at the side and said, "You just listened to your brother-in-law's nonsense. You followed Grand Master Dang Chao Wen, and then what?"
Yang Yi rolled his eyes at Yao Ji and said:
"My husband entered Grandmaster Wen's camp and became a cook. At this time, Grandmaster Wen was about to go to Xiqi to put down the rebellion."
"This matter is still a hidden danger left by the late king Wen Ding. Back then, Wu Yi used and supported Ji Li of the Zhou Dynasty to conquer the Rong and Di. Because of Ji Li's contribution, Wen Ding was canonized as Xibohou, granting him the right to command the western princes."
"However, as Ji Li fought successively and won a series of victories, his power expanded eastward. In the name of a reward, the late king Wen Ding lured Ji Li, who came to offer his victory, to the Shang capital and imprisoned him, and then killed him."
"Although it was to curb the expansion of the Zhou people, it directly led to the deterioration of Shang-Zhou relations. After Ji Li's death, his son Ji Chang inherited the title. After taking over, Ji Chang was thinking about revenge on the Shang Dynasty."
"This incident originally arose due to the rebellion of Dongyi. Ji Chang was unwilling to send troops to attack Dongyi, so Emperor Yi ordered Wen Taishi to attack Xiqi. There was originally a big war coming, which would definitely lead to a loss of lives."
"Your brother-in-law, I have a thorough understanding and know that most of the food and grass in Xiqi is provided by Donglu. So I risked my life to learn from your brother-in-law and told Grand Master Wen not to send troops. I just cut off the trade route from Donglu to Xiqi in the name of suppressing bandits."
"Within a month, Xiqi was already in chaos. Ji Chang also understood his shortcomings. In order to let Donglu's food come in, he attacked Dongyi."
"I heard that the Grand Master appreciated your brother-in-law, so he promoted him to become his advisor and nominated him as the grain inspector."
"This move is called subduing the enemy without fighting. Since then, Ji Chang has known the importance of food. I guess he is now leading people to reclaim wasteland."
"Then your brother-in-law soared into the sky. He followed Grand Master Wen to conquer the north and south, made great contributions, and finally rose to the top of the human world."
"Now that your brother-in-law meets the Human Emperor and refuses to worship him, and stamps his feet in Chaoge City, the whole world will tremble."
At this time, Long Ji's eyes had little stars popping out, "Brother-in-law is so amazing."
However, Yao Ji broke up the trouble at this time and said: "Long Ji, just listen to him. You should give me a try and see if Yangjiacun will collapse."
When Yang Yi heard this, he pointed at Yao Ji and said, "Madam, there is nothing you can do."
After some pleasantries, Yao Ji went to deliver silk to the town. Taking this opportunity, Long Ji slipped in and said with a mysterious face: "Brother-in-law, I believe everything you said."
Yang Yi glanced at it lightly and said, "It's all true. There's no point in believing it or not."
Long Ji said: "I think brother-in-law, you are a master of heaven and earth, can you give me some advice on how to practice? My brother-in-law can definitely tell with his sharp eyesight that I am a practicing person."
Yang Yi's heart moved, and he realized at this moment that Long Ji had probably gone to see Kong Xuan, and was embarrassed in front of Kong Xuan, so he was so honest.
"Your brother-in-law, I am just an ordinary person. How can I teach others how to practice? You should stop fooling around."
"I can't be out for too long. I have to go back tomorrow. Brother-in-law, please take pity on your sister-in-law."
Who would have thought that Long Ji would ignore Yang Yi and act coquettishly while holding Yang Yi's hand. The pair of them dangled in front of Yang Yi's eyes, making Yang Yi's heart skip a beat.
Seeing that Yang Yi was indifferent, Long Ji secretly came over and said, "IMy sister told me that she wants to get you a concubine. If you can do it, I can do it too. "
Hearing that Long Ji had such an idea, Yang Yi's head went dark. Since ancient times, it was the most difficult thing to bear the kindness of a beauty. Yang Yi flicked his gun and ran out of the study room. Long Ji chased him out and saw that Yang Yi had disappeared. Long Ji frowned in anger.
After leaving home, Yang Yi felt ashamed. The fairy who grew up in the Heavenly Palace had no involvement in the mortal world and was simple-minded. She even counted money for others after being sold.
